ITA-1.9.3.3.6 anityam अनित्यम्
Transient, perishable
Not everlasting, transient, occasional, incidental.

ITA-9.5.5 aninditaśalākā अनिन्दितशलाका
Ideal probe
The ideal type of probe for management of diseases of the head and neck region.

ITA-5.66.46 animittajanyadṛṣṭigatarogaḥ अनिमित्तजन्य-दृष्टिगतरोगः
Eye disorder with no particular cause; unknown cause
A disorder characterized by blindness; unclear vision; colour of eye resembling a cat’s-eye gem; occasional normal vision; fixed gaze; impairment of vision; bright-looking.

ITA-2.5.3 anilāyanam अनिलायनम्
Air passages
Passages for air inside the body.
